items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: And the other bands came in. Cab Calloway and finally Jimmie Lunceford and Blue Mills Blue Rhythm Ribbon bands.

ctx.x: I don't remember too well. But I think we were there about three months or something -- a couple of

months or something like that. Each year. And the other bands came in. Cab Calloway and finally Jimmie Lunceford and Blue Mills Blue Rhythm Ribbon bands. And all the different bands played the Cotton Club.
All right, you were -- you'd go out on the road in between the Cotton Club engagements.
